caption: The drawing depicts a single two-pronged fork-like object centered vertically on a plain, light beige background. The object has a metallic appearance, rendered in shades of grey and black, with shading to suggest depth. The upper part consists of two upward-curved, tapered prongs. The handle is long, straight, and narrows in the middle before thickening slightly toward the bottom. At the end of the handle, there is a small circular loop. The entire object is contained within a thin, black-lined rectangular border that is centered on the paper. There are no additional objects or decorative elements present in the image.
title: Fork
